data.answer: The company laptop is returned, and the device is wiped within 3 business days of the person's exit time.
All access is revoked within 4 hours of the person's exit time.
Yes, a web application firewall filters all inbound traffic.
When a bank forwards a request from an individual (access, correction or erasure), Nimbus Labs responds to the bank within 15 days.
Riya Sharma is the named privacy lead.
Nimbus Labs designs Nimbus Ledger Sync for alignment with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. This is a design goal, not a certification or a compliance statement.
Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Administrator accounts must use hardware security keys in addition to passwords. Shared accounts are not permitted.
The plan is exercised through a tabletop drill twice a year. The latest drill took place on 4 June 2026.
A customer administrator can request early deletion in writing. Nimbus Labs confirms completion by email within 10 business days of the request.
